kept.desc: Silent failure in fs.rmSync catch block leaves legacy cache file on disk without logging; security cleanup failure is invisible to caller

Error handler returns exception message potentially containing request values/tokens; original code explicitly prevented this for security but lacks TODO(handoff) marker, inconsistent with provision/run endpoint.
row() helper accesses result.rows[0] without checking if array is non-empty, returning undefined silently when no row exists; tests then crash with confusing TypeError.
catch block swallows database error from lease renewal without logging, reducing observability of heartbeat failures
job() helper destructures without checking if SELECT returned any rows; accessing row!.status will throw if query returns empty
salesOrder() helper destructures without checking if INSERT...RETURNING returned a row; row!.id will throw if empty
embedded.reason is used in template string without null/undefined check; even though embedded.state is checked, the reason property may not exist
